description: ZTE MF823 in a web composition (19d2:1403). A router inside the stick: cdc_ether or rndis_host and a DHCP address, no AT port in this composition; signal, operator and SMS over the ZTE goform web API at 192.168.0.1 (Referer and X-Requested-With needed, a session first on newer firmware), the web password in the modem's settings. The model is told by its web (model_name, or the firmware string such as BD_XBKZMF79N...). Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: imported catalog 19d2:1403 (mf823, hilink); another modem manager 3.5.8 hilink.sh (goform: Referer, X-Requested-With, session; MF79N firmware string); docs/modem-zoo/modems/zte-mf-family.md; docs/HANDOFF.md 162, 164
